data: CaliPopGen Dataset 2 DOI 10.6084/m9.figshare.15015927.v1, original MD5 ca8da2a8db1d87e81d982ff83ea8aff6
domain: Terrestrial, contemporaneous, within-species Fst pairs, 39 species and 43 study/species/marker groups before climate
response: Raw published Fst across contemporaneous population pairs, within-study/species/marker centered. NOT H_e, population-specific Fst, or spatial break position.
unit_of_replication: Species, with all study-marker groups of a species in the same train/test role
source_response_policy: Only after climate gate, read GenDist in original XLSX, parse finite scalar decimal float, numeric range -1 to 1; missing or non-float rows dropped with counts, no selection on sign; keep first repeated unordered pair in original source row order; drop exact zero-distance pairs
frozen_split: SHA256('calipopgen-fst-ttf-fresh-v01|'+lowercase binomial) first digest byte parity; 17/22 species before climate
climate: Original C1 SHA256-verified CHELSA-TraCE21k V1.0 21ka and 0BP four bioclim variables sampled at both present-day population locations
predictor_current: Euclidean distance between two 0 BP four-variable climate vectors, each variable divided by training population-site pooled SD
predictor_historical: Euclidean distance between two signed LGM-minus-0BP climate-change vectors, each variable divided by training population-site pooled SD of current 0BP same variable
geography: log(1+geodesic_distance_km), mean latitude, mean longitude (within California spatial gradient)
controls: Within study/species/marker intercept removed by centering both response and predictors; each group weighted equally; no mix of Fst with other distances; no cohort changes after opening
method: Equal study/species/marker-group-weighted ordinary least squares of within-group centered Fst; baseline geographic + present climate vs baseline plus exactly 1 historical predictor; outcome evaluated on species-disjoint held-out roles
estimand: Relative MSE reduction (baseline - augmented)/baseline on held-out species, each study/species/marker group weighted equally; no binning of Fst or genetic barrier thresholds
uncertainty: 1999 species-cluster paired bootstrap replicates, fixed seed 20261029; positive only if 2.5 percentile of gain >0
calibration: Synthetic known-truth worlds must show sensible null/positive behavior under the exact frozen estimator before any empirical Fst numeric values are read
conditions: No postoutcome tuning/ablation/threshold change to rescue failure
do not treat Fst as mapped genomic barrier location
unknown coordinate error remains quality limitation
No inference of geographic universality from California-only panel
Do not reopen closed GenDivRange H_e or TTF Phase4 results
